Record Class SimulationTickEvent

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.ether.society.events.SimulationTickEvent
Record Components:
tickIndex - monotonically increasing simulation tick counter
year - current simulated calendar year
month - current simulated month (0 to 11)
totalPopulation - aggregate living human population across all cells
currentTPS - instantaneous simulation ticks per second throughput
gdp - aggregate gross domestic product computed from physical capital
gini - Gini inequality coefficient of physical capital distribution (0.0 to 1.0)
yearChanged - true if this tick crossed a calendar year boundary
public record SimulationTickEvent(long tickIndex, int year, int month, long totalPopulation, double currentTPS, double gdp, double gini, boolean yearChanged) extends Record
Immutable telemetry record published at the conclusion of each simulation tick.

Provides decoupled, synchronous notification of macro-demographic, macroeconomic, temporal, and throughput observables without imposing direct dependencies on UI layers or specific presentation listeners.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
